source_definition: An official source criterion/evidence-area used to organise SbD requirements.
target_definition: A criterion grouping within an OSO under which requirement clauses are organised.

source_definition: A record or documented evidence item showing that an assurance-relevant activity, event or review occurred.
target_definition: A retained record of an activity, status, qualification, maintenance action, or other assurance-relevant fact.

source_definition: An adversarial role whose objectives, perspective or actions are considered in threat analysis.
target_definition: A person or organisation that can participate in, be responsible for, or provide services relevant to SORA assurance.

source_definition: Evidence that required personnel training has been delivered, maintained or assessed.
target_definition: A retained record of training completed or competence evidence.

source_definition: Conduct structured two-way communication of cybersecurity risks across organisational and supply-chain boundaries.
target_definition: A communications link used by the UAS or supporting systems.

source_definition: Documented information used to demonstrate or support fulfilment of an SbD requirement.
target_definition: A documentary information artefact used to define, support, or evidence SORA compliance.

source_definition: A function performed by or supported by a capability.
target_definition: A cybersecurity function or process such as authentication or authorisation.

source_definition: CADMID Assessment stage; used only where the requirement has a plausible assessment or acquisition applicability.
target_definition: A documented safety assessment used to support SORA assurance.

source_definition: The operational circumstances in which capabilities are provided and used.
target_definition: A non-actor element describing an operational boundary, configuration, resource, or environmental condition.

source_definition: Staff or personnel performing programme, security, operational, disposal, response or recovery activities.
target_definition: A human actor participating in the SORA assurance or UAS operational context.

source_definition: A design standard into which lessons learned and improvement information may be incorporated.
target_definition: An Airworthiness Design Standard used for UAS components essential to safe operations.

source_definition: A dependency on a single role or resource whose loss could undermine recovery capability.
target_definition: A failure of the UAS or supporting system relevant to safety or assurance.

source_definition: Data whose location, movement and compromise effects require explicit understanding.
target_definition: Data whose compromise or unavailability can affect safety-critical activities.

source_definition: The organisational circumstances on which programme cybersecurity strategy is based.
target_definition: The organisational culture supporting cyber safety and safety responsibilities.

source_definition: An official MOD Secure by Design requirement represented with its source identifier and exact wording.
target_definition: An official claimable SORA obligation from the controlled requirements register.

source_definition: CADMID Concept stage; used only where the requirement has a plausible early lifecycle applicability.
target_definition: Root grouping class for concepts required to represent the controlled SORA supplier-assurance domain.

source_definition: An informed decision by an accountable risk owner about the cyber risk held by a capability.
target_definition: An operational authorisation governing the approved UAS operation.

source_definition: A cyber threat or threat condition that informs risk appetite, assessment and security decisions.
target_definition: A controlled type of cybersecurity threat or attack referenced by the SORA Cyber Safety Extension.

source_definition: A governance body that reviews security, risk, performance or through-life management.
target_definition: A programme integrating relevant safety and security risk management activities.

source_definition: A threat, vulnerability, adverse event, risk, contributor or treatment concept relevant to SbD.
target_definition: A risk, hazard, failure, threat, event, or condition relevant to SORA safety or cyber safety.

source_definition: An information-bearing artefact used to demonstrate, support, verify or review fulfilment of a cybersecurity expectation.
target_definition: An artefact whose primary purpose is to support, state, or demonstrate assurance.

source_definition: A decision relating to cybersecurity, risk or programme action informed by relevant information.
target_definition: An industry-recognised cybersecurity accreditation.

source_definition: A control selected, monitored, reviewed or resourced to manage cybersecurity risk.
target_definition: A station used to control or supervise the unmanned aircraft.

source_definition: An abstract management concept used to govern cybersecurity decisions, risk, controls or awareness.
target_definition: An abstract cybersecurity or safety concept referenced by the SORA requirement set.

source_label: External Legal, Regulatory or Policy Requirement
source_definition: A legal, regulatory or policy requirement external to the SbD requirement set that a programme must understand or consider.
target_definition: A policy defining organisational expectations, controls, or responsibilities.

source_definition: Manage assets through life in line with MOD policy.
target_definition: A managed organisational system used to control an assurance-relevant domain.

source_definition: A direct reference or link to a named programme assurance artefact.
target_definition: A SORA element whose primary semantics are applicability or cross-reference to another requirement/source section.

source_definition: CADMID In-Service stage; used where operation, monitoring, incidents, backups, reporting or recovery indicate in-service relevance.
target_definition: A service external to the UAS/operator that supports the operation and may require assurance.

source_definition: An activity used to identify, assess, treat, communicate or monitor cyber risk.
target_definition: A controlled vocabulary entry identifying the kind of activity required or performed, such as audit, test, validation, monitoring, maintenance, or training.

source_definition: Risk arising from interacting technical, human, organisational, policy and workflow factors.
target_definition: A technical system, component, communication element, or interface relevant to the SORA requirements.

source_definition: A Defence strategic objective to which delivered capabilities contribute.
target_definition: A safety objective or desired safety outcome referenced in SORA requirements.

source_definition: Choose, plan, track and communicate a response to identified risk.
target_definition: The plan addressing hazardous secondary or escalating effects after loss of control.

source_definition: An adverse cybersecurity event affecting a capability, system, data or essential function.
target_definition: A controlled type of security event or indicator, such as anomaly, suspicious activity, malicious activity, or security breach.

source_definition: A system whose compromise or adverse technological change could affect essential programme functions.
target_definition: An information-technology system used by an applicant/operator or supporting organisation.

source_definition: Implement corrective actions that address weaknesses or improve resilience.
target_definition: Removable electronic media used in maintenance or data transfer.

source_definition: A role held by a party with needs, expectations, responsibilities or decision interests in the programme or capability.
target_definition: An official Low/Medium/High register placeholder whose source content is N/A or otherwise non-positive.

source_definition: CADMID Manufacture stage; used where component/design/manufacturing applicability is plausible.
target_definition: A controlled manual describing information, procedures, or instructions.

source_definition: Apply physical, technical or cryptographic protections to data.
target_definition: A data communications link, which may be operational, safety-related, or payload-related depending on context.

source_definition: Protection of data from unauthorised or undetected alteration.
target_definition: An interface through which actors or systems interact.

source_definition: Information supplied to an accountable risk owner to support an informed risk decision.
target_definition: A declaration made by an applicant/operator as a permitted assurance method at lower assurance levels.

source_definition: Integrate and monitor secure development practices throughout delivery.
target_definition: Equipment relevant to manufacturing, operation, maintenance, or assurance.

source_definition: Maintain and regularly review an inventory of programme data.
target_definition: A log recording maintenance performed on the UAS.

source_definition: A specialist external or internal role that augments cyber incident recovery capability.
target_definition: A checklist used to perform or evidence defined operational or assurance steps.

source_definition: Integrate secure practices throughout capability development and delivery.
target_definition: The designed or permitted flight envelope relevant to operational safety and protection functions.
